brief:
Palestinian freelancer Mahmoud Abu Hamda won the photography category at the prestigious Bayeux award for war correspondents, Al-Monitor reported. Abu Hamda received the prize Saturday for his coverage from Gaza.

The Bayeux award recognizes international journalism documenting armed conflict and its impact on civilians. The honor places Abu Hamda among photographers recognized for documenting conflict zones at significant personal risk.
dek: Palestinian freelancer Mahmoud Abu Hamda on Saturday won the photography category in the prestigious Bayeux award for war correspondents for his work from Gaza.
title: Palestinian photographer Abu Hamda wins Bayeux war correspondents award
